items.title: JPMorgan, Apollo Urge Inflation Focus for Warsh’s Big Speech
items.summary: A chorus of investors is urging Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh to provide a strong rebuke of high inflation to boost the long end of the Treasury market.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Soars After Q2 Earnings: Is NVDA Still a Buy?
items.summary: Nvidia stock has surged more than 7% on Thursday after the AI chip giant delivered another blockbuster quarterly report yesterday evening.

items.title: Apollo Buys Into Atlantic Aviation at Near $10 Billion Valuation
items.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is acquiring a co-controlling stake in Atlantic Aviation from rival KKR & Co. that values the private jet fixed-base operator at nearly $10 billion.

items.title: Enbridge Forms $1.95 Billion Joint Venture to Expand British Columbia Pipeline
items.summary: Enbridge has partnered with private equity companies KKR and Apollo Global Management to fund a 2.7 billion Canadian dollar, or $1.95 billion, expansion of its natural gas pipeline system in British Columbia.
